contentText: Iranian Deputy Foreign Minister Kazem Gharibabadi said Wednesday that Tehran would use some of its frozen assets in Qatar to purchase goods needed by the country following talks in Doha. Under the memorandum of understanding that halted the war between Iran and the US, Washington agreed to make available Iran's frozen or restricted assets as part of the agreement's implementation. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.
